figures.title: Per-type fraction-of-swap (behavior)
figures.transform: per (type-cell x slot x arm): drop pairs with |ceiling-floor| < 0.5 (anchor separation, judge-contrast units); per surviving pair, F_beh = (mean patched contrast - floor mean)/(ceiling mean - floor mean) over K=5 coherent draws; arm mean over surviving pairs; pair-clustered bootstrap 95% CI, B=10,000, seed 21620
figures.plotted_quantity: mean behavior fraction-of-swap F_beh per type (steered / shuffled-donor null / cross-type-donor null bars), one panel per slot, post-exclusion n per type

figures.title: Per-type F_beh - per-pair companion
figures.transform: same exclusion as per_type_f_beh; NO aggregation: one point per surviving pair per arm (pair mean over K=5 coherent draws), labeled by pair id
figures.plotted_quantity: per-pair F_beh points behind arm means, per type x slot

figures.title: Read x write 2x2 (probe AUC vs causal F)
figures.transform: x = max-over-28-layers macro AUC (leave-one-carrier-out folds) per (type x slot); y = steered mean F_beh (separation-excluded, as per_type_f_beh); quadrant thresholds = the registered verdicts (causal-positive: clears BOTH nulls disjoint-CI + Holm IUT; probe-positive: max-AUC clears the max-selected permutation 97.5th band)
figures.plotted_quantity: one point per (type x slot) in the AUC-vs-F plane, quadrants labeled stored-and-used / stored-but-unusable / used-but-not-decoded / absent

figures.title: Probe AUC per layer - per-unit companion of the 2x2
figures.transform: per (type x slot x layer): macro AUC over the 3 value-pairs (carrier folds) plus the label-permutation band (B=1,000, within-carrier shuffles); no max taken in this view
figures.plotted_quantity: AUC vs layer curves per type/slot with permutation bands and per-value-pair points

figures.title: Stage-2 layer profile (post-selection)
figures.transform: per surviving (type-cell x slot): mean F_beh over surviving pairs at each (layer in {8,12,14,16,19,22,26} x dose in {1,4}), greedy 1 draw; steered minus shuffled-donor-null companion
figures.plotted_quantity: type x layer heatmap of stage-2 F_beh at doses 1 and 4 (labeled post-selection)

figures.title: Stage-2 per-pair companion
figures.transform: no aggregation: per-pair F_beh points at each survivor's best stage-2 (layer, dose), steered and null interleaved, labeled by pair id
figures.plotted_quantity: per-pair stage-2 F_beh points per survivor cell

figures.title: Route contrasts at matched content
figures.transform: steered mean F_beh (separation-excluded, pair-clustered bootstrap CI) for the matched-content route sets {instr_format vs demo_format; persona_prompted vs demo_persona vs persona_role_header; instr_language vs language_implied} plus the 4 conflict cells' balance shift = (judge_demo - judge_instr)/100 normalized floor-to-ceiling
figures.plotted_quantity: F_beh per route variant at matched content, per slot; conflict balance shift per conflict cell

figures.title: Route contrasts - per-pair companion
figures.transform: no aggregation: per-pair F_beh / balance-shift points for every route-variant and conflict cell, labeled by pair id
figures.plotted_quantity: per-pair points behind each route/conflict bar

figures.title: Recency and load curves
figures.transform: per crossed type: steered mean F_beh (separation-excluded) at depth {1,3,5} and load {1,3,5} (depth/load 1 = the base cell), pair-clustered bootstrap CIs; registered secondary slope = pair-clustered bootstrap CI on the per-pair depth/load slope
figures.plotted_quantity: F_beh vs conversation depth and F_beh vs information load, one curve per crossed type per slot, null band behind

figures.title: Recency/load - per-pair companion
figures.transform: no aggregation: per-pair F_beh at each depth/load level, lines connecting the same pair across levels
figures.plotted_quantity: per-pair F_beh trajectories across depth/load levels

figures.title: Anchor separation per pair (pre-exclusion)
figures.transform: per pair: ceiling mean minus floor mean (judge-contrast units) from K=10 anchor draws; histogram/strip per type with the 0.5 exclusion bar drawn; pre- and post-exclusion counts per type
figures.plotted_quantity: per-pair anchor separation distributions per type, exclusion bar at 0.5

figures.title: F_act vs F_beh agreement
figures.transform: per (type-cell x slot x arm): mean F_act (read layer 26, disjoint floor halves) vs mean F_beh over the same surviving pairs; Spearman rho across cells with dynamic range reported in-panel
figures.plotted_quantity: F_act vs F_beh scatter, one point per cell-arm, colored by arm

figures.title: Teacher-forced margin vs F_beh (dual-DV validation)
figures.transform: per (type-cell x slot): mean TF margin shift (steered minus floor, length-normalized lnP over the fixed 4+4 pools) vs mean F_beh; Spearman rho across cells with dynamic range = the registered rule-19 validation, reported before the margin carries any read
figures.plotted_quantity: margin shift vs F_beh scatter with the validation rho

figures.title: Coherence and cap-hit diagnostics
figures.transform: per (type-cell x slot x arm): incoherent fraction (score <= 60) minus the anchor baseline rate; cap-hit fraction (length == max_new_tokens) with the 2% re-gen trigger drawn
figures.plotted_quantity: excess incoherence and cap-hit fraction per cell-arm panels
